contribution.position: I hold my earlier position, and I must directly answer qa: qa claims artifact:perf-report shows peak_memory of 380MB, but that datum does not appear in the artifact list — the actual artifact:perf-report text states peak_memory measured 740MB at peak load against a 512MB budget. Qa's 'risk is contained' conclusion therefore rests on a number the evidence does not contain, and the 44% memory overage stands uncorrected. This strengthens rather than weakens the reliability concern: with two sev2 incidents last quarter traced to retry storms (artifact:incident-log), shipping a worker that exceeds its memory budget under peak load recreates the resource-pressure conditions behind those incidents, and artifact:test-report (412 passed, 87% coverage) does not exercise memory headroom at peak. Until the 740MB measurement is explained or brought under budget, the reliability axis opposes shipping this week.
